items.title: CAM-142 · Customer Authentication Migration
items.text:
SAMPLE — fictional data for the TabForest demo. Contoso Ltd. is a fictional company.

# CAM-142 · Customer Authentication Migration

Contoso Ltd. · Jira Software · Project **CAM** (Customer Accounts & Membership) / CAM-142

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | Story |
| Status | **IN PROGRESS** |
| Priority | High |
| Assignee | Priya Shah |
| Reporter | Marcus Lee |
| Sprint | CAM Sprint 14 (Sep 14 – Sep 25) |
| Story points | 13 |
| Labels | `auth` `azure` `fabrikam` `q4-commit` |
| Components | identity, customer-portal |
| Epic link | CAM-100 Platform modernization FY27 |
| Fix version | 2026.11 |
| Watchers | 6 |
| Created | 2026-09-02 · Updated 2026-09-23 |

## Description

**Goal:** Migrate customer authentication to Azure before the Fabrikam go-live, without forcing existing customers to reset their passwords.

Today every customer portal login goes through the on-prem identity box (`idp01`). It is out of vendor support in March, it does not scale for the 8–9 a.m. login peak, and Fabrikam's security questionnaire flagged it twice. The plan is a small token service on Azure, the portal moved to an OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE, and `idp01` retired after a two-week dual-run.

Hosting for the token service is not decided yet (Functions vs App Service), see arch sync on 9/22. Plan doc: *Customer Auth Migration Plan* (Confluence, CAM space).

Out of scope: employee SSO, the partner API keys, MFA changes (CAM-160).

~~Use the legacy cookie domain for the callback~~ (dropped, see Sam's comment)

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] App registration created in the Contoso tenant (staging + prod redirect URIs)
- [ ] Token service deployed to Azure in staging and prod
- [ ] OAuth callback (`/auth/callback`) tested end to end against the Fabrikam test tenant
- [ ] Existing customers can sign in after cutover without a password reset
- [ ] Refresh tokens survive the cutover, OR users are asked to sign in again at most once
- [ ] Rollback rehearsed in staging (migration plan §4)
- [ ] Runbook + on-call notes updated
- [ ] App Insights dashboard for login success rate and p95 latency

## Sub-tasks

| Key | Summary | Assignee | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| CAM-143 | Token service skeleton | Priya Shah | IN REVIEW (PR #418) |
| CAM-144 | App registration + redirect URIs | Sam Rivera | DONE |
| CAM-145 | OAuth callback handler `/auth/callback` | You | IN PROGRESS |
| CAM-146 | Session storage design | Unassigned | TO DO |
| CAM-147 | Cutover runbook | Marcus Lee | TO DO |

Linked issues: *blocks* CAM-150 (Fabrikam onboarding) · *relates to* CAM-160 (MFA) · *is cloned by* CAM-151 (do not use, created by mistake)

## Activity

**Marcus Lee** · 2026-09-02 09:14
Created from the Q4 architecture review. Priya to own the overall story, sub-tasks below.

**Jira Automation** · 2026-09-02 09:14
Added to board *CAM Kanban*. Story points estimate missing.

**Dana Ortiz** · 2026-09-05 16:40
Fabrikam is targeting go-live on Nov 3 and they keep asking if SSO comes "for free" with this. It does not, but I'd like a one-liner I can send them. Linking my account note in the CAM space.

**Marcus Lee** · 2026-09-09 11:02
Assigning the OAuth callback work to You (CAM-145), since you set up the portal redirect URIs last time. Priya stays on the token service itself.

**You** · 2026-09-09 11:20
👍 Will pick it up after the CAM-139 hotfix ships.

**Sam Rivera** · 2026-09-12 15:31
App registration done. Redirect URIs are in for staging and prod. The prod one is a placeholder hostname until hosting is decided. Also: please don't use the legacy cookie domain for the callback, it breaks SameSite in Safari.

**Priya Shah** · 2026-09-17 18:05
Draft PR #418 is up. Token issue + validate work locally. End-to-end is blocked until Fabrikam sends test credentials.

**Jira Automation** · 2026-09-21 08:00
Sprint *CAM Sprint 14* ends in 4 days. 3 sub-tasks are not done.

**Dana Ortiz** · 2026-09-22 10:12
Unrelated, but does anyone know if the Fabrikam renewal includes the support add-on? Asking here because their procurement person cc'd this thread.

**You** · 2026-09-23 17:48
Callback route works against the staging app registration with the mock IdP. Still need the real Fabrikam tenant before I can call it tested.

**Marcus Lee** · 2026-09-23 18:02
Thanks. Moving to Sprint 15 if it slips, no drama.

items.text:
SAMPLE — fictional data for the TabForest demo. Contoso Ltd. is a fictional company.

# Token service on Azure Functions (WIP) #418

**Draft** · Priya Shah (@pshah) wants to merge 9 commits into `main` from `ps/cam-143-token-service`

Contoso Ltd. / `customer-portal` · Labels: `cam-142` `auth` `do-not-merge` · Reviewers: Marcus Lee, Sam Rivera, You · Linked: CAM-142, CAM-143
Checks: ❌ 1 failing, ✅ 4 passing · +612 −48 · 14 files changed

## Description

Adds the customer token service under `src/token-service/` as an Azure Function app.

What's in here:
- `POST /token` (authorization code + PKCE → access token + refresh token)
- `POST /token/validate` for the portal middleware
- Signing key read from Key Vault via app setting reference (cached for 5 min)
- App Insights request telemetry, no token values logged

Not yet:
- `POST /token/refresh` is stubbed (returns 501)
- Session handling is still the in-memory dict in `session.py` (temporary!)
- No end-to-end test against the Fabrikam tenant (see below)

How to test locally:
```
cd src/token-service
func start
curl -X POST localhost:7071/api/token -d @samples/code_exchange.json
```

## Timeline

- **Priya Shah** opened this as a draft · 2026-09-17
- **github-actions** ❌ CI / unit-tests failed: `test_refresh_rotation` timed out after 30 s (1 failed, 214 passed)
- **Priya Shah** commented · 2026-09-17
  > CI failure is the flaky refresh test again, it's stubbed in this PR anyway. Re-running.
- **github-actions** ❌ CI / unit-tests failed: `test_refresh_rotation` timed out after 30 s (1 failed, 214 passed)

### Review: Sam Rivera commented on `src/token-service/issue_token.py` · 2026-09-18

```python
40    def issue(code: str, verifier: str) -> dict:
41        claims = _exchange(code, verifier)
42 +      tkn = _sign(claims, ttl=TOKEN_TTL_SECS)
43 +      return {"access_token": tkn, "token_type": "Bearer"}
```
> nit: `tkn` → `token`, we're not paying per character 🙂

**Priya Shah** replied
> fair, will rename

### Review: Marcus Lee commented on `src/token-service/config.py` · 2026-09-18

> `TOKEN_TTL_SECS` vs `TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` in the portal config. Can we pick one? I don't care which, just the same in both repos.

**Priya Shah** replied
> going with `TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS`, will fix in the next push

### Review: Sam Rivera commented on `src/token-service/session.py` · 2026-09-18

```python
 8 +  _SESSIONS: dict[str, Session] = {}
```
> Where should session state live once this runs on Functions? This dict won't survive scale-out or a restart, and the portal assumes sessions stick around for 12 h. Redis? Cosmos? Something else?

- **Renovate** bumped `azure-functions` 1.20.0 → 1.21.3 on `main` · 2026-09-19
- **Marcus Lee** commented · 2026-09-19
  > Mind rebasing on main? The functions bump touches `host.json`.
- **Priya Shah** pushed 3 commits · 2026-09-19
- **github-actions** ✅ CI / unit-tests passed (215 passed)
- **github-actions** ✅ CI / lint passed

**Priya Shah** commented · 2026-09-21
> Heads up: the customer test credentials have not arrived, so I can't run the end-to-end flow against the Fabrikam tenant yet. I'll follow up with the customer tomorrow and cc Dana so it doesn't get lost again.

**You** commented · 2026-09-21
> Rebased my callback branch on this. `/auth/callback` is stubbed on the portal side and will exchange the code against `POST /token` once this merges. Nothing to review from me yet.

- **Priya Shah** changed the title ~~Token service skeleton (hosting TBD)~~ **Token service on Azure Functions (WIP)** · 2026-09-22
- **Priya Shah** pushed 2 commits · 2026-09-22
  - `host.json`: Premium plan settings, one always-ready instance
  - rename `tkn` → `token`, `TOKEN_TTL_SECS` → `TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS`
- **github-actions** ❌ CI / unit-tests failed: `test_refresh_rotation` timed out after 30 s (1 failed, 216 passed)

**Sam Rivera** commented · 2026-09-22
> The flaky test is tracked in CAM-139, not this PR. Someone please quarantine it, I'm tired of seeing red.

**Marcus Lee** commented · 2026-09-23
> Not approving yet since it's a draft. Ping me when the e2e run passes. Also please add the App Insights dashboard link to the description.

**Dana Ortiz** was mentioned · 2026-09-23

---
This pull request is still a work in progress. Merging is blocked: 1 failing check, 0 approvals, draft.

items.title: Account note: Fabrikam
items.text:
SAMPLE — fictional data for the TabForest demo. Contoso Ltd. is a fictional company.

# Account note: Fabrikam

Contoso Ltd. · CRM account note · Author: Dana Ortiz (Account Manager) · 2026-09-11
Account: **Fabrikam, Inc.** (fictional) · Segment: Enterprise · Stage: Onboarding

**Contact:** Jordan Blake, IT lead at Fabrikam (prefers email, slow on Teams). Backup contact is their service desk queue, which never answers.

Call with Jordan today, 30 min, mostly about the go-live.

- **Timeline pressure.** Fabrikam wants customer logins live by **Nov 3**. Their CFO is demoing the portal to their board the week after, so Nov 3 is "not really movable" (Jordan's words). I told them the auth migration (CAM-142) is on track but I'd confirm after our arch sync.
- **Test credentials.** Jordan promised test tenant credentials for our engineers by **Tuesday 9/15**: two test users plus a client secret for their staging identity provider. They come from their security team, not from Jordan directly, so they may slip. I'll chase if Priya doesn't have them by Wednesday.
- They asked whether SSO for their employees comes "for free" with the migration. Said no, out of scope, can quote separately.
- Security questionnaire: they're happy now that the on-prem box is going away. Want a one-page summary of where tokens are stored. (Ask Marcus.)

Noise / other stuff from the call:

- Renewal question: does the renewal in January include the premium support add-on, or was that a one-year promo? Need to check with Finance before I answer. Not related to the migration.
- They're moving offices in December; new billing address to follow.
- Jordan mentioned they had a bad experience with a previous vendor's "big bang" cutover, so a gradual rollout will land well.
- Lunch at their office next visit: no seafood (allergy on their team).

Next steps:
1. Confirm go-live readiness with Marcus after 9/22.
2. Chase test credentials with Jordan if not received by 9/16.
3. Finance: renewal + support add-on.

items.title: Teams transcript excerpt: CAM arch sync 2026-09-22
items.text:
00:07:58.800 --> 00:08:10.050
<v Priya Shah>The other thing, and this is the annoying one, we still don't have test credentials from Fabrikam. I can't run the end-to-end flow against their tenant without them.

00:08:10.400 --> 00:08:15.000
<v Marcus Lee>Still? Dana said they were coming last Tuesday.

00:08:15.300 --> 00:08:21.700
<v Priya Shah>Still. I'll ping their IT contact again today and loop Dana in.

00:09:30.200 --> 00:09:41.900
<v Sam Rivera>Can I ask a dumb question? If the token service is stateless on Functions, where does session state actually get stored? Redis, Cosmos, something else?

00:09:42.300 --> 00:09:47.800
<v Marcus Lee>Not dumb. Let's park it for a sec, I want to land hosting first.

00:09:48.000 --> 00:09:49.200
<v Sam Rivera>Sure.

00:11:05.600 --> 00:11:16.400
<v You>For what it's worth, the Functions version of the PR is already half there. Priya's branch has the token endpoint working locally.

00:11:16.700 --> 00:11:24.900
<v Priya Shah>Half there is generous. The refresh endpoint is stubbed and CI is red because of a flaky test that has nothing to do with me.

00:11:25.100 --> 00:11:27.300
<v Sam Rivera>It's always the flaky test.

00:12:30.000 --> 00:12:43.800
<v Marcus Lee>Okay. Deployment-wise both are fine. Monitoring-wise both go to the same App Insights. So it really comes down to cost and the spiky traffic.

00:13:20.500 --> 00:13:31.200
<v Priya Shah>And with App Service we'd size for the 8 a.m. peak all day. With Functions we don't.

00:13:31.500 --> 00:13:38.000
<v Sam Rivera>I'm fine either way honestly, I just don't want two hosting models for one login flow.

00:13:58.000 --> 00:14:05.400
<v You>The portal stays on App Service regardless, right? We're only talking about the token service.

00:14:05.700 --> 00:14:09.800
<v Marcus Lee>Only the token service. Portal doesn't move.

00:14:32.000 --> 00:14:41.600
<v Marcus Lee>Okay, decision then. For the token service we'll go with Functions, Premium plan, one always-ready instance. App Service stays for the portal.

00:14:42.000 --> 00:14:46.300
<v Priya Shah>Great. I'll update the PR title and the doc.

00:14:46.500 --> 00:14:49.900
<v Sam Rivera>Works for me.

00:15:40.300 --> 00:15:53.700
<v Marcus Lee>Next, cutover. Everyone please read section 4 of the migration doc, cutover and rollback, before Thursday. That's the part I'm least confident in.

00:15:54.000 --> 00:16:03.100
<v You>Is the rollback still just flip the flag back? Because refresh tokens issued by the new service won't be valid on the old box.

00:16:03.400 --> 00:16:11.800
<v Marcus Lee>That's exactly why I want eyes on section 4. Leave comments in the doc.

00:17:10.900 --> 00:17:19.400
<v Priya Shah>Unrelated, but whoever booked the big room on Friday, it's double booked with the design review.

00:17:19.600 --> 00:17:22.300
<v Sam Rivera>That's me, I'll move it.

00:18:25.000 --> 00:18:37.200
<v You>On my side, I'm on the OAuth callback. I'll test it against the staging app registration this week, but the real test needs the Fabrikam tenant.

00:18:37.500 --> 00:18:41.900
<v Priya Shah>Which needs the credentials. Yeah. I'm on it.

00:19:52.300 --> 00:20:04.800
<v You>Going back to Sam's thing from earlier. We never said where session state should be stored, did we? The doc still says TBD.

00:20:05.100 --> 00:20:12.600
<v Marcus Lee>Hmm. Let's take that one offline, I don't want to guess on the call. Sam, can you add it to the open items?
